status: Isolated proposal; shipping public/ is unchanged.
method: Paid current-game campaigns; 1x pace. Identical policies and paired seeds; no granted capital. Finite capable heuristics, not a global optimum.

definitions.all: Every recorded purchase action, including hires, population, buildings and unlocks.
definitions.upgrades: Personal/helper skills, Match/All, yard upgrades, research unlocks and hive upgrades. Excludes hires, bees, new buildings, land, shafts and mining machines.
definitions.personal: Personal/helper skill purchase actions including Match/All. The campaign buyers use individual purchases.
definitions.cadence: Elapsed game minutes, including research, saving, travel boarding and all mandatory waits; excludes offline yard time and final cinematic. Phase gaps do not cross travel boundaries; whole-campaign gaps concatenate active phases.
definitions.bins: Full wall-aligned game-minute bins per phase, without the final partial minute; five-minute bins include the partial tail.

manifest.method: 20 Hz actual game economy; one-second decisions; actual offers and charges; real research, letters and boarding; home/hollow/return; no grants, jumps or injected progress. Finale begins at finish; cinematic duration excluded. Seed resets each visit. Browser timers/rendering disabled.

treads.name: Rubber treads
treads.desc: Four new wheel upgrades for every Robot.

claw.name: Telescoping claw rake
claw.desc: Four combined claw and reach upgrades: scoop up more leaves from further away, up to 12 leaves a grab and 125 cm reach.

hubs.name: Ball-bearing hubs
hubs.desc: Two stronger wheel upgrades, up to 3.30× speed.

hopper.name: Spring hopper
hopper.desc: Two bigger basket upgrades, up to 38 leaves.

wrist.name: Gyro wrist
wrist.desc: A faster pickup upgrade: 0.44 seconds a grab.

fineWrist.name: Fine control
fineWrist.desc: The final pickup upgrade: 0.32 seconds a grab.

diamond.name: Power tools
diamond.desc: ⁣Four Operate machinery upgrades: faster mining and sawing, and faster furnaces and kilns.

horseshoe.name: Master’s touch
horseshoe.desc: Three more Resource efficiency upgrades: up to a 72% chance of an extra chunk of metal or log, and up to +36% from each kiln or furnace batch.

pincers.name: Hydraulic pincers
pincers.desc: Three stronger tree shaking upgrades: more leaves from every tree and bush.

jig.name: Packing jig
jig.desc: ⁣Two faster Load & pack upgrades: bagging, jars and cans, gift wrapping, and loading furnaces and kilns.

precision.name: Precision tools
precision.desc: Two advanced Load & pack upgrades, up to 4.60× speed.

cyclone.name: Grit cyclone
cyclone.desc: Two stronger excavating upgrades for Blowers at a mine shaft.

forge.name: Forge blast
forge.desc: Two stronger bellows upgrades for Blowers at the smelting plant.

kiln.name: Hot-air stove
kiln.desc: Two faster leaf drying upgrades for Blowers at the drying bench.

tunnel.name: Drying tunnel
tunnel.desc: The last two leaf drying upgrades: a covered tunnel of hot air over the tray.
